basis: Official Seoul Metropolitan Government administrative heritage height reference, from Attached Table 2 of the heritage preservation ordinance (Article 18), Remarks / Height of cultural heritage. Used as an overall model envelope because retained source building height_m is absent; not claimed to be a current survey or eave/ridge measurement.
supports: The official table explicitly lists Sungnyemun: 19 m as heritage height.
This supports an explicit reference height rather than storeys multiplied by a modern office storey height.
The reference table does not identify precise ground/ridge survey datum or pavilion-only dimensions.
footprintCaution: Input footprint contains complete retained plan mass including masonry. Its dimensions must not be stated as measured wooden pavilion dimensions. The height applies to the gate ensemble envelope, not just its two wooden storeys.
